speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this rash, and does it spread to other parts of your body? Also, do you notice any changes in your skin texture or color, such as thickening or discoloration?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a specific exposure to plants or insects while working on your rice farm or with the livestock that might irritate your skin or affect your nerves? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Liver Function Tests, and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning, as a pneumonia diagnosis doesn't explain your chronic rash or the numbness/tingling in your palms; could you describe the appearance of the rash on your hands more specifically? REQUEST TEST: ANA, Rheumatoid Factor, Anti-CCP, and Serum Vitamin B12.
